notes: Fires when the user wants the reusable review checklist or review standards to apply, not an active review of specific code. Boundary routes concrete diff/PR reviews to review-code.

evals.prompt: What should I check before approving a PR? Give me a comprehensive code review checklist.
evals.expected_output: Returns the checklist reference — correctness/security/performance/code-quality/testing/documentation items, the anti-patterns-to-flag table, review comment conventions (BLOCKING/SUGGESTION/NIT/QUESTION), and PASS/NEEDS WORK/BLOCKED verdict criteria.

evals.prompt: We're establishing code review standards for the team. What should our review checklist cover?
evals.expected_output: Provides the standardized checklist categories and review conventions as reusable review criteria, without reviewing any particular codebase or producing a REVIEW artifact.

evals.prompt: Review my auth service code and tell me exactly what's wrong before merge.
evals.expected_output: Should route to review-code / not fire, because the user names specific code to actively review and wants concrete findings plus a verdict — that is an active review (review-code), not a request for the checklist reference.
